summary.en: Use the **present simple** for habits, routines, facts and things that stay the same: _I start work at nine. She lives in Leeds._ Add **-s** for he, she and it. Make questions with **do / does** and negatives with **don't / doesn't**, and then use the base verb: _Does she work here? She doesn't work here._
summary.es: Se usa para hábitos, rutinas y hechos. Con he/she/it, el verbo lleva -s. En preguntas y negativas usa do/does y don't/doesn't, y el verbo vuelve a la forma base (sin -s).

form: **I / you / we / they** + base verb: _I work, they live._
**He / she / it** + verb + **-s**: _She works._ Add **-es** after -s, -sh, -ch, -x and -o (_watches, goes_); consonant + y becomes **-ies** (_studies_).
Questions: **Do / Does** + subject + base verb: _Do you work here? Does he work here?_
Negatives: **don't / doesn't** + base verb: _I don't work. She doesn't work._
Frequency adverbs go **before** the main verb but **after** be: _I always walk to work. She is never late._

uses.text: **Habits and routines** → _I get up at seven. We have dinner at nine._

note.en: Time words: every day, on Mondays, twice a week, in the evening.
note.es: Palabras típicas: every day, on Mondays, twice a week, in the evening.

uses.text: **Facts and permanent situations** → _My brother lives in Bilbao. The shop opens at ten._
**How often?** → always, usually, often, sometimes, never: _He sometimes cycles to work._
**Short answers** → repeat do / does: _Do you like jazz? Yes, I do. / No, I don't._

note.en: Do not repeat the main verb in a short answer.
note.es: En la respuesta corta no se repite el verbo principal.

why.en: With he, she and it the verb needs -s.
After does the verb goes back to the base form. The -s is already in does.
why.es: Después de does, verbo sin -s: la -s ya está en does.

why.en: English negatives use don't or doesn't, not no.
why.es: La negación es don't / doesn't, no «no».

why.en: After doesn't use the base verb: have, not has.
why.es: Tras doesn't, verbo base: have, no has.

mistakes.wrong: I go always to the gym.
mistakes.right: I always go to the gym.

why.en: Frequency adverbs go before the main verb, not after it.
why.es: El adverbio de frecuencia va antes del verbo, no después.

examples.en: I usually leave home at half past seven.
examples.es: Normalmente salgo de casa a las siete y media.

examples.en: My sister teaches maths at a secondary school.
examples.es: Mi hermana da clases de matemáticas en un instituto.

examples.en: The library closes at eight on weekdays.
Do you take the bus or the train to work?
examples.es: ¿Vas al trabajo en autobús o en tren?

examples.en: Does your brother live near you?
We don't watch much television in the evening.
examples.es: No vemos mucho la tele por la noche.

examples.en: She doesn't eat meat, but she eats fish.
I never drink coffee after lunch.
Tom is always the first person in the office.
How often do you visit your grandparents?

practice.prompt: My neighbour ___ the piano every evening.

explanation.en: A routine with he, she or it takes the verb with -s.

practice.prompt: ___ your parents live in the city centre?

explanation.en: Your parents is plural (they), so the question uses do.
After doesn't the verb stays in the base form.

practice.prompt: I ___ walk to the office when it rains.

explanation.en: Never already makes the sentence negative and goes before the verb.
